experiment: C18 exploratory self-anchored compressed-interface transfer to SmallViT hierarchy

naive_sketch_16.interpretation: unanchored partial sketch worsened functional fidelity in both eligible seeds

absolute_utility_failure.interpretation: the tested 4096-parameter token-wise grammar cannot preserve the full four-block SmallViT task function; therefore C18 is not evidence for useful full-span Transformer compression

execution_provenance.local_execution: logic-equivalent standalone mirror of the committed runner because the connector and execution container do not share a filesystem

interpretation: The qualitative self-anchor ordering transferred to both eligible SmallViT teacher seeds: full hidden alignment was best, anchored half-interface next, anchored quarter-interface next, frozen next, and naive unanchored sketch worst.
This is a relative mechanism signal only. The full four-block token-wise replacement grammar collapsed task accuracy to chance even for the direct-original control.
Do not promote C18 to confirmatory cross-architecture interface-compression evidence. A better-utility SmallViT span/grammar is required for the next experiment.
